role.name: This device is
role.hint: Table: the shared screen that shows the map and the paths players drag. Mobile: shows only your character sheet and the move grid, for a tablet or phone. Follow GM assignment: uses the role the GM gave your user, and without one phones of non-GM users become mobiles. Set this only if this device should ignore the GM's assignment.

padColumns.name: Grid columns on the mobile
padColumns.hint: The fewest grid cells across the mobile's move grid. The grid also always shows at least 11 rows, on a short screen the cells get smaller so both fit.

maxSteps.name: Longest path (cells)
maxSteps.hint: Paths longer than this are cut off. The drag path is sent to the table screen, this keeps messages small.

stepDelay.name: Movement speed (ms per cell)
stepDelay.hint: How long the token takes per cell when a player confirms a move from their mobile.

assign.menuHint: Decide per user whether they use a mobile, the table screen or a normal client, and which characters a mobile user can pick.
assign.title: Roles and characters
assign.hint: Auto: players' phones become mobiles, everything else (also tablets) is a normal Foundry client, so give tablets the Mobile role. Characters: what the user can pick on the mobile. Leave empty to offer every character the user owns. Only owned characters can be moved, grant ownership in the actor's permissions. Seat: the edge of the table screen the player sits at, so up on their mobile means away from them on the table. Changes apply at once, a changed role reloads that user's browser.
assign.notOwner: This user does not own this character and cannot move its token.

phone.exitText: This device switches back to the normal Foundry screen. Closing this browser tab brings mobile mode back.
phone.noCharacter: No character is available for your user. The GM can assign one in Module Settings, Roles and characters.
phone.sheetFailed: The character sheet could not be opened: {error}
phone.sheetMissing: The character sheet did not open. Check the browser console for errors.
phone.hint: Double-tap the grid where your character is, keep your finger down on the second tap and drag the path.
phone.confirmHint: Tap the destination to move, double-tap anywhere else to cancel.
phone.noTable: The table screen did not answer. Is it connected and set to Table?
phone.paused: The game is paused. Tap the destination again once it continues, or double-tap to cancel.
phone.blocked: A wall is in the way, the path was shortened.

err.no-token: Your character has no token on the table's scene.
err.no-scene: The table screen has no scene loaded.
err.not-owner: You do not own this character.
err.bad-path: The table screen rejected the path.
err.table-error: The table screen hit an error, see its browser console.

door.gm-error: The GM could not do it

phone.reloading: Switching this device to mobile mode...
